name: fmage
description: Generate and edit images through configurable OpenAI-compatible providers with Codex-revised prompts and explicit separation of delivery quality parameters from visual style.

interface.shortDescription: Provider-neutral GPT Image generation and editing.
interface.longDescription: Adds first-class image generation and editing tools with prompts revised by the active Codex model, switchable local provider configuration, and guardrails that keep quality tiers such as low/1K separate from sketch or wireframe styling. API keys remain outside the shareable plugin directory.
defaultPrompt: Edit this reference image with Fmage.
